name: Omakase Doukoukai
source:
Main character attends school theater club. Participants work hard together, and satisfaction from well done job can grow into something more...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公参加了学校的戏剧社。成员们齐心协力、刻苦排练，而完成出色演出所带来的满足感，也可能逐渐发展成更深的感情…
